D: A dinosaur theme park goes wrong when the power goes off.
P: Serve dessert when Hammond eats melting ice cream in the dark visitor centre.
S: Brown butter sugar cookie dough wrapped around a chocolate egg, shaped into ovals, baked at 175C for 12 minutes, speckled with cocoa and gold dust.
Nedry's smuggling kit, hidden in plain sight

Crustless finger sandwiches of smoked chicken, avocado, cream cheese and chives on soft white bread, stacked into a tin and kept cold. Mix 150g cream cheese with 2 tbsp snipped chives and lemon zest. Mash 1 avocado with lemon juice and salt. Spread 8 slices soft white bread with the cream cheese. Top 4 slices with mashed avocado and 250g sliced smoked chicken, then close with the other 4. Press lightly, trim the crusts and cut each into 3 fingers. Stack in a tin, cover and chill 20 minutes.
clever girl, in the long grass
Flour tortillas cut into curved claw shapes, brushed with oil, salt and smoked paprika, baked at 200C for 8 minutes. Guacamole.
M: the lunch where Grant, Sattler and Malcolm argue with Hammond
Herb-crusted rack of lamb roasted at 220C to 55C, rested, with a crushed pea and mint purée and roast baby potatoes, plated like a fancy park restaurant.
the T. rex gets the goat, you get the ribs

Pork ribs rubbed with brown sugar, paprika and garlic, wrapped and baked until tender, then glazed with smoky barbecue sauce under a hot grill. Mix 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Rub over 2 racks pork ribs (about 2kg). Wrap each rack tightly in foil and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Unwrap, brush thickly with 250ml barbecue sauce mixed with 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar and grill under high heat for 5 minutes until sticky and charred. Rest 5 minutes and cut between the bones.
W: Three scoops of vanilla bean ice cream in a chilled coupe with hot fudge and crushed honeycomb, served slightly too soft like the freezers are off. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge. Leave 1L vanilla ice cream out for 10 minutes so it softens a little too much. Scoop three each into chilled coupes, pour over the fudge and scatter crushed honeycomb.
K: Ripple glass lime and mint iced tea

Chilled black tea sweetened with honey and shaken with fresh lime and mint, served in tall clear glasses on the table so you can watch them ripple. Brew 4 black tea bags in 1 litre boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and stir in 4 tbsp honey. Cool and chill 2 hours. Muddle 12 mint leaves with the juice of 2 limes in a jug, add the tea and stir. Fill 4 tall clear glasses with ice, pour in the tea and garnish with lime wheels and mint.

flavour.sign: Isla Nublar. Opening soon. Stay with your tour vehicle.

note.text: The ice cream is melting, the power's down, and I've just had the sundae bar flown in. Eat it anyway, it'll be lovely.

steps.text: Brown the butter in a small pan and cool for 10 minutes until just warm.
Beat the butter with the sugar and egg, then mix in the flour to a soft dough.
Wrap the dough around each chocolate egg, shape into ovals and place on a lined tray.
Bake at 175C until set and lightly golden, then cool.
Mix the cocoa with a little water and flick over the cookies with a brush for speckles.

dishes.make_ahead: Crisps up to 1 day, guacamole on the day

steps.text: Cut the tortillas into curved claw shapes.
Brush with oil and sprinkle with half the salt and the smoked paprika.
Bake at 200C on lined trays until crisp.
Mash the avocados with the lime juice and remaining salt for the guacamole. Serve with the crisps.

dishes.make_ahead: Crumb the lamb up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Brush the lamb racks with Dijon, then press on the parsley and breadcrumbs.
Toss the potatoes in oil and salt and put on a tray in a 220C oven.
Roast the lamb alongside the potatoes until 55C inside, about 20 minutes.
Rest the lamb 10 minutes while you boil the peas with the mint, drain and blitz with the butter. Slice the lamb and plate neatly.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the eggplant up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Score the eggplant flesh, brush with half the oil and roast cut side up at 220C for 20 minutes.
Toss the potatoes in the rest of the oil and salt and put in the oven alongside.
Brush the eggplant with Dijon, press on the parsley, breadcrumbs and parmesan and roast until golden.
Boil the peas with the mint, drain and blitz with the butter. Plate the eggplant neatly with the potatoes and peas.

dishes.make_ahead: Fudge up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Melt the chocolate with the cream over low heat for hot fudge, stirring until smooth.
Leave the ice cream out for 10 minutes so it softens a little too much.
Scoop three each into chilled coupes, pour over the fudge and scatter with crushed honeycomb.

dishes.n: Ripple glass lime and mint iced tea

ingredients.item: mint leaves, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and stir in the honey.
Cool, then chill for 2 hours (included in cook time).
Muddle the mint with the juice of 2 limes in a jug, add the tea and stir.
Fill tall clear glasses with ice, pour in the tea and garnish with lime wheels and mint.

s.how: Brown 125g butter and cool. Beat with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 225g flour. Wrap dough around 12 small chocolate eggs, shape into ovals and bake at 175C for 12 minutes. Flick with cocoa mixed with a little water for speckles.

s.note: clever girl, in the long grass
s.how: Cut 6 flour tortillas into curved claw shapes. Brush with oil, sprinkle with salt and smoked paprika and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp. Mash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes and salt for guacamole.

m.note: the lunch where Grant, Sattler and Malcolm argue with Hammond
m.how: Brush 2 lamb racks with Dijon and press on chopped parsley and breadcrumbs. Roast at 220C until 55C inside, about 20 minutes, and rest. Boil 300g peas with mint and blitz with butter. Roast 800g baby potatoes. Slice and plate neatly.

w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge. Leave 1L vanilla ice cream out for 10 minutes so it softens a little too much. Scoop three each into chilled coupes, pour over the fudge and scatter crushed honeycomb.

d.n: Ripple glass lime and mint iced tea
d.how: Brew 4 black tea bags in 1 litre boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and stir in 4 tbsp honey. Cool and chill 2 hours. Muddle 12 mint leaves with the juice of 2 limes in a jug, add the tea and stir. Fill 4 tall clear glasses with ice, pour in the tea and garnish with lime wheels and mint.
